Ad. Buying someone a Bluetooth tracker? Check their phone first.
iPhone or iPad → AirTag
Android → a Find Hub tag
Google lists its Pixel Tag as coming this month at £29, or £99 for four.
Guide: https://homo1006.github.io/#tech-gifts

The 100W on a charger box is usually shared between the ports.
Most thin laptops need 45–65W, so check what one port gives with everything plugged in.

Ad. Noise-cancelling headphones under £100:
Over-ear for the desk: Sony WH-CH720N. £99 list price, £68 at Amazon in March according to What Hi-Fi?.
Earbuds for the commute: Anker Liberty 4NC, typically under £100 according to Which?.
Check the returns policy, because hygiene rules can limit it.
Guide: https://homo1006.github.io/#tech-gifts

Ad. New guide: cook for less this winter.
Which? tested frozen chips at 8p in an air fryer against 23p in an electric oven, at the 26.32p/kWh cap rate.
What size to buy for one, two or a family, and when a slow cooker makes more sense.
Guide: https://homo1006.github.io/#cheaper-cooking

What's the one thing you'd never cook in an air fryer?
Mine's anything with a runny batter. Tell me I'm wrong.

A heated airer costs the same per hour whether it's full or half empty.
Fill every bar before you switch it on. Which? also found covers didn't make drying any faster.

Ad. Slow cooker size rule from Which?: about one litre per serving.
3.5L for two or three. 6L or more for a family or batch cooking.
Running costs vary too: Which? puts an eight-hour stew at about 16p in an efficient model and 40p in the least efficient.
Guide: https://homo1006.github.io/#cheaper-cooking

How are you drying clothes this winter?
Heated airer, tumble dryer, radiators, or just hoping?

Ad. No tumble dryer? Two buys for drying washing indoors:
A heated airer. Which? averages them at about 8p an hour.
A dehumidifier. Go 18L a day or more if laundry dries indoors.
If you already have a tumble dryer, Which? says it's likely faster and cheaper.
Guide: https://homo1006.github.io/#winter-warmth

Ad. Feeding a family? A dual-zone air fryer lets the chips and the main finish together.
Black Friday benchmark: TechRadar listed the Ninja AF300UK 7.6L at £129 at Amazon on 6 November, down from £199.99. Prices move, so check before you buy.
Guide: https://homo1006.github.io/#cheaper-cooking
